topic: How to Read a Commercial Rent Roll
caption:
Reading a commercial rent roll is one of the most practical skills an investor, landlord, or business owner can master. A clear rent roll shows who occupies space, how leases are structured, and where revenue and tenant liabilities come from — essential for underwriting, budgeting, and planning property improvements. Start by confirming tenant names and unit IDs, then verify lease start and end dates, rent amounts, expense responsibilities, concessions, and any free rent. Flag upcoming expirations and ambiguous expense language. For owners in Chester County and Montgomery County, use the rent roll to prioritize lease renewals, tailor local leasing strategies, and spot management issues. Need a checklist or a one-on-one review? Visit dmsellscre.com/investors to get a starter guide and schedule a quick consult.
